reviewText:
**Approve the bounded TAC-10 implementation attempt, with the two mandatory contract corrections below.** I found no additional prerequisite requiring a separate module before this work. This approves implementation of the amended contract at [f4a4c0bc](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/f4a4c0bca3b917842dd16e2f215053b6cfb55fbb/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-tac10-undead-amended-contract/SOURCE_API_CONTRACT.md), subject to recording these corrections and Codex agreement. It does not accept the resulting runtime.

1. **Preserve all seven supported Bishop spells.** Section 7’s “supported six-spell casting” must include the six original procedures **plus earned Dispel Magic (Lesser)**. Dispel uses the same calendar admission machinery. Retain its existing restriction to the caster’s own historical Guidance, currently individually perceived through Detect, with original cast provenance. Neither its ownership nor its operational access should disappear in the new epoch.

2. **Outside-initiative tearing spends the existing owning Action.** Section 5 must distinguish scheduled `WorldIntervals` from genuinely off-calendar `WorldActivityIntervals`. A party actor cannot acquire a second Action ledger merely because combat is closed.

   For this ordinary-world physical procedure, an actor may spend its retained, unspent Action even when another actor owns the current virtual slot, subject to all applicable authority, condition, physical-access and work restrictions. Tactical tearing requires the actor’s own regular turn. The tear commits immediately without advancing the clock; ordinary advancement reaches its deadline. Mode changes, entry and restore grant no extra Action. This does not broaden casting or Rite timing.

The remaining source/API decisions are sufficiently bound:

| Area | Decision |
|---|---|
| **Creature origin and defenses** | Approve the disjoint non-class origin, unavailable PB, unsupported generic affected-PB Bleeding, exact printed numerics, shared typed defenses and separately sourced Poisoned prevention. Preserve the previously approved, specifically bounded living-recipient ruling. |
| **Claw and continuations** | Approve actual source Claw through regular attacks, opportunities, Press and Sanctuary. Suppression cannot produce an unarmed fallback. Pending retarget/forgo, cached decline, authority and replay must retain the complete original attack identity and payload. |
| **Authored context** | Approve the fresh genesis actor, bright ordinary 30ft observation, nonblocking post/seal, precontact hold and ambient participation. Hold supplies no invulnerability. Existing cross-roster exclusions remain; every otherwise reachable ambient producer needs an actual safe admission path. |
| **Paid contact and funding** | Approve the proposed route and current post-recovery defender-Start admission gate. Preserve preceding party Ends, actual costs, carried allowances and genuine initiative. The new connected execution remains mandatory. |
| **Suppression timing** | Retain `O + 6(k + 2)` for initiative rupture and rupture time plus six seconds outside initiative. Preserve that original endpoint across closure and epoch changes. Process only legitimately due Ends; never manufacture old-epoch Ends or decay/recharge credits. |
| **Persistence and evidence allocation** | Approve additive wire114/base90 with a distinct appended marker and trusted composition over geometry113. Preserve old encodings and profile boundaries. The specific mechanical allocation for necrotic, poison and Poisoned remains approved; it does not replace genuine Claw, rupture, suppression, recovered attack and continuation. |

Two implementation details deserve explicit regression coverage. Sanctuary continuation currently reconstructs the existing combat payload, so adding a command kind alone will not preserve the new source attack. Pending knockout reconstruction also uses retained effective damage: it must not apply resistance again or consume another damage roll.

The route arithmetic checks out: nine normal cardinal edges total **45ft**, or **nine active seconds at unchanged 30ft speed**, before calendar alignment. They avoid the corpse, blockers and weighted cells. Both staged party positions are 10ft from the Wraith and 5ft from the seal; the Wraith therefore still needs genuine movement before Claw. This establishes static feasibility, not successful gameplay or survival.

I independently:

- Read the complete contract, prior decisions, canonical creature extract, inventories and relevant accepted implementation.
- Confirmed the engine diff against `7261052ae4dec908f8c0ac38e0a2c5f4b831065b` is empty.
- Rehashed all **493 pinned Git blobs**, checking their identities, lengths and SHA256 values.
- Executed the supplied Python source audit and disposition generator in an isolated review copy: **25 assertions passed**, the **461-file** inventory reproduced, and the **332 numeric/PB rows across 81 files** reconciled.
- Rehashed the accepted geometry archive and reproduced the retained r327 route-state extract.
- Used separate read-only reviews of numerical/combat and context/timing boundaries.

I did **not** compile C#, execute gameplay, restore saves, observe workers or prove the new campaign. The lexical inventories remain inventories, not semantic completeness proofs.

Implementation must still qualify the genuine connected route, five execution paths, authentic95–113 continuations and views, privacy/authority/forgery/backup controls, builds/static checks, and the complete original **1,576 predecessors plus new cases**, followed by actual final review.

The dependency map remains unchanged. After creature qualification, return the **amended complete Consecration contract**; Consecration runtime is not authorized here. Whole-engine/P1/production remain open, Unity remains deferred, and storage/Support remain held.

codexAgreement.scope: Bounded TAC-10 implementation attempt, subject to recorded mandatory corrections; not runtime acceptance
codexAgreement.reason: The actual review approves the complete bounded contract without another prerequisite. Codex independently confirms the existing earned Dispel source and shared casting gate, and the distinct scheduled/off-calendar Action ledgers. Both mandatory corrections preserve accepted functionality and prevent duplicate Actions.
mandatoryCorrections: Preserve all seven supported Bishop spells, including earned Dispel Magic (Lesser), with existing own historical Guidance, individual Detect perception, original cast provenance and exact calendar gates.

Outside-initiative tear spends the actor's actual owning WorldInterval or off-calendar WorldActivityInterval, never both. Retained unspent ordinary-world Action may be used during another virtual slot; tactical tear requires own regular turn. Immediate commit with no clock advance, no extra Action on entry/mode/restore; no broader casting/Rite timing.
regressionRequirements: Sanctuary retarget/forgo/cached decline preserve full source attack and payload.
Pending knockout applies retained effective damage once without another resistance pass or damage draw.
